title: SwarmEvolve Trace Line (v1 + v2)
description: One JSON Lines record produced by the SwarmEvolve engine (see SPECIFICATION.md §4.1). Each tick the engine emits exactly one such object on its own line; the final line additionally carries the `outcome` field. Schema version 1 (legacy) contains only {tick, team_a, team_b, outcome?}. Schema version 2 (M15a, opt-in via --record-actions) additionally carries {schema_version, actions_a, actions_b, attacks} and is used by the telemetry/AAR toolchain. Both versions validate against this schema — v2-only fields are marked optional.

schema_version.description: Emitted only by v2 (--record-actions). v1 lines omit this field. When present, must equal 2.

tick.description: Zero-indexed tick number. Tick 0 is the pre-movement spawn snapshot.

team_a.description: Snapshot of Team A drones at the end of this tick.

team_b.description: Snapshot of Team B drones at the end of this tick.

actions_a.description: Team A per-drone actions applied during this tick. Present only in v2. One entry per Team A drone (same order as team_a). Dead drones have zeroed action fields.

actions_b.description: Team B per-drone actions applied during this tick. Present only in v2. Same contract as actions_a.

attacks.description: Resolved attack events for this tick. Present only in v2. Empty array on tick 0 and on ticks where no attacker was both alive, off-cooldown, and had a valid target_id. One entry per committed attempt; `hit` discriminates landed vs missed shots.

outcome.description: Terminal outcome tag. Only present on the final trace line.

x.description: Drone X position (arena units). The engine emits with %.2f precision.

y.description: Drone Y position (arena units, Y-down per SPECIFICATION §1.2).

cooldown.description: Remaining attack-cooldown ticks. 0 means ready to fire.

alive.description: True iff this drone is still alive at the end of the tick.

id.description: Drone id, matches the DroneState entry at the same position.

alive.description: Whether the drone was alive at query time this tick. If false, all action fields are zeroed.

vx.description: X component of the velocity vector (pre-clamp). Emitted with %.4f precision.

vy.description: Y component of the velocity vector (pre-clamp). Emitted with %.4f precision.

target_id.description: Enemy id targeted this tick, -1 for no attack. Out-of-range ids are treated as no-ops by combat resolution.

msg.description: Broadcast message out (MSG_SIZE == 4 floats). Delivered to teammates next tick.

atk_team.description: Attacker team id. 0 = Team A, 1 = Team B.

atk_id.description: Attacker drone id within its team.

tgt_team.description: Target team id. 0 = Team A, 1 = Team B. Always opposite of atk_team.

tgt_id.description: Target drone id within its team.

hit.description: True iff the attacker was in range AND the target was alive at resolution time. False for out-of-range attempts and attempts at already-dead targets.

dist.description: Euclidean distance between attacker and target at resolution time. Emitted with %.4f precision.
